description: This is a PHP script for executing scheduled jobs in a SuiteCRM environment. It initializes necessary system components, verifies CLI execution, retrieves job and client IDs from command line arguments, and runs a specified scheduler job.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: Represents the system user, fetched via BeanFactory for executing the job.

classes.name: SchedulersJob
classes.description: Handles execution of scheduled jobs, invoked via static method runJobId.

classes.name: DBManager
classes.description: Database connection manager, used to disconnect after job execution.

methods.name: runJobId
methods.description: Static method to execute a scheduled job by its ID and client ID.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Fetches system user details for job execution context.
